title: The Real Reason You Can't Focus After Lunch (It's Not About Food)
script: There's a 2pm crash sitting on you right now and it's not about what you ate. It's biology. Scientists call it the postprandial dip — your brain genuinely loses capacity in the early afternoon, combining with a natural circadian low point. Fighting through it costs you hours of low-quality work. The fix? Don't push through. Take a 10-minute walk, do your hardest task first thing in the morning, and save administrative work for the dip. Work with your biology, not against it.
